fusions.name: Flat Skim
fusions.desc: Skims a javelin low that deals 12 water damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles. It then skips to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Fowler's Throw
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Throws a fowling javelin up to 7 tiles that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Slides Off the Shaft
fusions.desc: Raises a guard that absorbs the next 20 damage, up to 3 blows, for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6%.

fusions.name: Wader's Footing
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you attack 4% faster, from silver your dodge chance rises by 5%, and from gold you move 8% faster.
